mapper.select: SELECT v.tenant_id,v.project_id,h.config_id, v.agent_version_id AS version_id,'AGENT' AS kind,v.name, JSON_OBJECT('dependency_manifest',v.dependency_manifest,'limits',v.limits) AS projection v.capability_version AS version_id,v.kind,NULL AS name, JSON_OBJECT('input_schema_ref',v.input_schema_ref,'output_schema_ref',v.output_schema_ref,'tool_scope',v.tool_scope,'artifact_digest',v.artifact_digest) AS projection , v.content_sha256,r.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,v.status,h.status AS head_status,h.current_version, v.schema_version,v.schema_manifest_sha256,v.created_by,v.created_at,v.classification FROM agent_versioncapability_version v JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND h.config_id= v.agent_idv.config_id AND h.kind=v.configuration_kind AND h.project_id <=> v.project_id JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND r.version_id= v.agent_version_idv.capability_version AND r.entity_kind=#{entityKind} AND r.owner_project_id <=> v.project_id WHERE v.agent_version_idv.capability_version=#{versionId} AND v.revision=1 AND h.revision=1 AND v.evaluation_id IS NULL AND h.name=v.name FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.upstream_version_id AS version_id,e.relation_kind,r.content_sha256 FROM lineage_edge e JOIN version_registry r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.version_id=e.upstream_version_id WHERE e.consumer_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY e.relation_kind,e.upstream_version_id
mapper.update: UPDATE configuration_head SET current_version=#{versionId} WHERE config_id=#{configId} AND kind=#{headKind} AND current_version IS NULL AND status='DRAFT' AND revision=1
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET governance_epoch=governance_epoch+1 WHERE governance_epoch=#{governanceEpoch} AND auth_epoch=#{authEpoch}
mapper.select: SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{configId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type='configuration.draft_created'
